title: learn-observation
description: One observation of a phase, whole-overwritten after each approved phase while the mode is not `off`, at the logical name `feature:<slug>:learning:observation:<N>` (F106-FR-006, feature 106 T010). A phase with no telemetry is no error: the observation member is null.

shape.description: The phase shape the observation was taken under

generated_at.description: UTC to the second of the write

observation.description: The per-phase figures, the members of a `phases` entry of specstride.learn.summary/7; null when the phase has no telemetry

inputs.description: The events read and the phase shapes used
